scientific_boundary: Island-level native incidence was frozen before any A-Islands species-fold support-model performance or EOG reachability result was inspected. Cleaning rules were declared before the incidence counts were generated.

incidence_rule.taxon_status: Status_APC == native from the upstream frozen cohort
incidence_rule.retained_source_row: A row supports primary native incidence unless Naturalised==1 or Native==0 when those local status fields are explicitly numeric.
incidence_rule.unknown_local_status: Missing, NA or non-numeric local status does not erase an APC-native record.
incidence_rule.island_presence: 1 when at least one retained source row exists for the species across any flora list for the island; otherwise 0 within the 842-island surveyed universe.

execution_gate.on_mismatch: Fail before support-model fitting or EOG reachability evaluation. Do not update the accepted incidence hashes from benchmark outcomes.
